verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public REST API that exchanges JSON over HTTPS, with guides for OAuth, filtering and sorting, rate limiting (429 with Retry-After), and webhooks. A public OpenAPI 3.1 spec is served at api.attio.com/openapi/api; the probe's 404s were only at docs-site paths, so they do not contradict it. An llms.txt and an official MCP server further support AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully driving the API end-to-end.
